column2: Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
My power just went out. Is there an outage in my area?
I can check that for you. What is the ZIP code of the address without power?

Thanks. There is a known outage in 90001 affecting about 1,240 customers, caused by storm damage to a main line. The estimated restoration time is 6:30 PM today. Since we already know about it, you don't need to file a separate report. Would you like restoration text alerts?
Yes please.
What mobile number should we text? Updates will include any change to the restoration time and a message when power is back.
You're signed up for restoration alerts for ZIP 90001. Reply STOP at any time to cancel. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's all. Thanks!
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
I want to report a power outage.
I'm sorry your power is out. Before we start, is anyone in danger, or do you see a downed power line, sparks, or fire?
No, nothing like that. Just no power.
Thanks. What's the ZIP code of the address without power?
I don't see a known outage in 90002 yet. Have you checked your circuit breakers, and do your neighbors have power?
Breakers look fine and the whole street is dark.
Thank you. To file the report I just need the last 4 digits of the phone number on the account.
Your outage report is filed. Your ticket number is BV-48213. A crew will be assigned to investigate, and I can sign you up for text alerts so you get updates.
That's fine, thanks.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
Do you need my account number to report an outage?
No. To report an outage we only need the ZIP code and the last 4 digits of the phone number on the account. Please never share your full account number, Social Security number, or passwords in chat.
Okay good. ZIP is 90004 and the last four are 2290.
Thank you. I've filed your outage report. Your ticket number is BV-48377. Would you like restoration alerts by text?
No thanks.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
Only half of my house has power. The kitchen and living room are dead but the bedrooms work.
That's called a partial outage. First, please check your circuit breaker panel for any tripped breakers and reset them.
I already did that. Nothing is tripped.
Thanks. When breakers are fine, a partial outage can mean a problem with the service line to your home. I'll report it as a partial outage so a crew can check it. What's your ZIP code?
And the last 4 digits of the phone number on the account?
Your partial outage report is filed with ticket number BV-48402. Please stay away from your meter and the service wires if they look damaged.
Will do, thank you.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
Why does my neighbor across the street have power and I don't?

Homes on the same street can be served by different power lines, transformers, or circuits. Your home may also have damage to its own service line. If your neighbors have power and you don't, please report your outage so a crew can check your line. Would you like me to report it now?
Yes. ZIP 90002, last four 7781.
Done. Your ticket number is BV-48455. A crew will check the service line to your home.
Thanks.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
My restoration time changed from 4 PM to 9 PM. Why does it keep changing?

I'm sorry for the frustration. The estimated restoration time is our best estimate based on the damage found so far. It can change when crews assess the damage, find more of it, or have to pause because of unsafe weather. We update it as soon as we know more.
So 9 PM isn't guaranteed?
Correct, it's an estimate, not a guarantee. Restoration alerts will text you if it changes again. Would you like to sign up?
You're signed up. You'll get a text when the estimate changes and when power is restored.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
The outage map says my restoration time is Assessing. What does that mean?
During large storms, crews need to inspect the damage before they can give an estimate. Assessing means a crew hasn't finished inspecting your area yet. An estimated time will appear once they have.
How long does that usually take?

It depends on the size of the storm. In major storms, most customers are restored within 2 to 3 days, but that's a typical range, not a promise. I'd recommend signing up for text alerts so you hear as soon as an estimate is available.
Okay, thanks.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
I already reported my outage this morning. Should I report it again?

No need. Duplicate reports don't speed up restoration. Your report is grouped with others nearby so crews can find the source faster. If you'd like updates, I can sign you up for restoration text alerts.
Yes, please do that. 555-0119, ZIP 90001.
You're all set. You'll get a text when the restoration estimate changes and when power is back.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
Why do the hospitals get power back before my neighborhood?

We restore power in a safety-based order. First we handle public safety hazards like downed lines, then critical facilities such as hospitals, emergency services, and water treatment plants. After that we repair transmission lines and substations, then main lines that serve the most customers, then smaller neighborhood lines, and finally individual service lines to single homes.
So single houses are last?
Yes, because one repair to a main line can restore thousands of customers at once. Crews work through every level as quickly and safely as possible.
Makes sense, thanks.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
How long do outages usually last after a big storm?

Typical ranges are 2 to 6 hours for small local outages, most customers within 24 hours for moderate storms, and most customers within 2 to 3 days after major storms. Your actual time depends on the damage in your area.
Can I ask the crew on my street when they'll be done?
For safety, please don't approach crews or work areas. For updates, you can use this chat, our website, or restoration text alerts.
Got it.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
There's a power line down in my front yard.

This is an emergency. Stay at least 35 feet away from the line and keep children and pets away. Assume it's live. Please call 911 and our 24-hour Emergency Line at (800) 555-0111 right now so we can send a crew immediately. Downed lines must be reported by phone, not chat.
Okay, calling now.
Thank you. Please don't touch the line or anything it's touching, such as a fence, tree, or puddle.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
A tree fell and it's leaning on the power lines behind my house.

Please stay well away from the tree and the lines. A tree touching power lines is dangerous. Call 911 and our Emergency Line at (800) 555-0111 right away. Never try to move the tree or trim branches near power lines yourself.
Thanks, I'll call.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
A wire fell on my car while I was driving. I'm still inside.

Stay inside the car and call 911 now. Warn others to stay away. Only leave the car if it's on fire. If you must leave, jump clear with both feet together without touching the car and the ground at the same time, then shuffle away with small steps.
Okay, calling 911.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
The transformer on the pole outside is sparking and smoking.
Please keep your distance, at least 35 feet, and keep others away. Call 911 and our Emergency Line at (800) 555-0111 immediately so a crew can be dispatched. This needs to be reported by phone.
Calling now.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
I smell gas in my kitchen. Can you help?

Please leave the building right away. Don't use light switches or phones inside. From a safe place, call 911 and your gas provider. Brightvale Electric provides electricity only, so your gas provider will handle the leak.
Okay, leaving now.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
My basement is flooding and the power is still on. What should I do?

Do not enter the flooded basement while the electricity may be on. Call our Emergency Line at (800) 555-0111 and we can disconnect power to your home for safety. Don't use appliances that have been in water until a licensed electrician inspects them.
Thank you, I'll call them now.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
Is it okay to run my generator in the garage with the door open?

No. Never run a generator inside a garage, home, basement, or shed, even with the door open. Generators produce carbon monoxide, an odorless gas that can kill within minutes. Run it outdoors at least 20 feet from your home with the exhaust pointed away from doors and windows.
Wow, I didn't know that. Thanks.
You're welcome. Also make sure you have battery-powered carbon monoxide alarms on every level of your home.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
Can I plug my generator into a wall outlet to power the whole house?

Please don't. That's called backfeeding, and it can send electricity back into power lines and seriously injure or kill utility workers and neighbors. Plug appliances directly into the generator with heavy-duty outdoor extension cords. A whole-house generator must be installed by a licensed electrician with an approved transfer switch.
Okay, understood.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
My CO alarm is beeping and my son has a headache.

Get everyone outside to fresh air immediately and call 911. A headache, dizziness, or nausea with a carbon monoxide alarm can mean carbon monoxide poisoning. Don't go back inside until emergency services say it's safe.
Going outside now.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
My power has been out for 5 hours. Is the food in my fridge still safe?

A closed refrigerator keeps food safe for about 4 hours. Since it has been 5 hours, perishable foods like meat, dairy, and leftovers may not be safe. When in doubt, throw it out, and never taste food to check. Going forward, move perishables into a cooler with ice after 4 hours.
What about the freezer?
A full freezer keeps its temperature for about 48 hours, and a half-full freezer for about 24 hours, as long as the door stays closed.
Thanks.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
I keep insulin in the fridge. What should I do during the outage?

Please ask your pharmacist or doctor how long your insulin can safely stay at room temperature and what to do if it gets too warm. Don't use medicine that looks unusual or has changed color. A cooler with ice packs can help. You may also want to enroll in our Medical Priority program for priority callbacks during outages.
How do I enroll?
Complete the Medical Priority application on our website and have it signed by a licensed medical provider. I can also arrange a callback from our Medical Priority team to help you start.
Please arrange a callback.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
What should I do with my TV and computer while the power is out?

Unplug sensitive electronics like computers and TVs to protect them from surges when power returns. Leave one light switched on so you know when power is back, and turn major appliances back on one at a time.
Great tip, thanks.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
It's really hot and my AC isn't working because of the outage. Where can I go?

During extended outages in extreme heat, Brightvale County opens cooling centers. During declared storm emergencies we list open centers here and on our website. Please drink plenty of water. If anyone feels unwell from the heat, call 911.
Okay, thank you.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
My mother uses an oxygen concentrator and our power is out.
If she's in any danger or having trouble breathing, please call 911 right now. Does she have a backup oxygen supply or battery, and is she safe at the moment?
She has a backup tank for a few hours. She's okay right now.

Thank you. I'm flagging this as a Medical Priority case and requesting a priority callback from our Medical Priority team. During storm emergencies they usually call within 15 minutes. Please have a backup plan ready if the outage lasts longer than her backup supply. You can also reach the Medical Priority line at (800) 555-0155.
Thank you so much.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
If I sign up for Medical Priority, will my power come back first?

No, and I want to be clear about that. Medical Priority customers get priority callbacks, check-in calls, and advance notice of planned outages, but restoration follows a safety-based order because one repair can restore many homes at once. Medical Priority customers need a backup plan. If anyone is ever in danger, call 911.
Understood.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
Who qualifies for the Medical Priority program?

Any residential customer with a household member who relies on powered medical equipment, such as an oxygen concentrator, home dialysis, a ventilator, a CPAP machine, or refrigerated medicine. The application must be signed by a licensed medical provider, enrollment is confirmed within 5 business days, and it's renewed every 2 years.
Thanks, I'll apply.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
Do you warn medical customers before planned maintenance outages?
Yes. We notify all affected customers at least 48 hours before a planned outage, and Medical Priority customers also receive a phone call.
Good to know.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
I can't pay my bill this week. Can I get more time?
I can help with a payment extension. How many days do you need?
About 10 days.
To check eligibility I need your ZIP code and the last 4 digits of the phone number on the account.
Good news. Your 10-day extension is approved. Your new due date is in 10 days, with no fee and no late charge if you pay by then.
Thank you!
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
I need a month to pay my bill.
Extensions of up to 14 days can be approved right away. Requests for 15 to 30 days are reviewed by our Customer Care team. Would you like me to create a review request for 30 days?
Yes please.
I've created your review request. Customer Care will contact you within 2 business days. Approval isn't guaranteed, and if your balance is large, they can also discuss a payment plan.
Okay, thanks.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
I got an extension two months ago. Can I get another one?

Automatic extensions are available once every 12 months. A second extension within 12 months needs review by our Customer Care team. I can submit a review request, and they'll contact you within 2 business days.
Please submit it.
Done. Your request has been sent to Customer Care.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
Will I get a late fee because the storm knocked out my power and I couldn't pay?
During a declared storm emergency, late fees are waived for bills due during the emergency and for 14 days afterwards, and service isn't disconnected for non-payment during the emergency.
That's a relief.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
I'm behind on several bills. Can I set up a payment plan?

Yes. A payment plan lets you spread a past-due balance over 3 to 12 monthly payments added to your regular bill. Payment plans are set up by our Customer Care team. Would you like me to connect you or book a callback?
A callback tomorrow morning would be good.
I've booked a callback with Customer Care for tomorrow morning.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
Is there any help for people who can't afford their electric bill?

Yes. Brightvale Helping Hands offers a one-time bill credit of up to $150 per year for income-qualified households. We also offer Budget Billing, which keeps your monthly bill the same all year, and a 10% discount on the energy charge for qualifying seniors and customers with disabilities.
How do I apply for Helping Hands?
Applications are reviewed by our Customer Care team. I can connect you with them. For your safety, we never ask for your full Social Security number or bank details in chat.
Please connect me.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
What is budget billing?
Budget Billing lets you pay the same amount every month based on your average yearly usage, so higher summer or winter bills are easier to plan for.
Thanks.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
All the food in my freezer spoiled after the storm. Can I get reimbursed?

I'm sorry about your food. Outages caused by storms or severe weather are generally not eligible for reimbursement. However, if your power was out for more than 72 hours in a row during a declared storm emergency, you'll automatically receive a one-time $50 Storm Relief Credit on your next bill.
It was out for 4 days.
Then you should see the $50 Storm Relief Credit on your next bill automatically. You don't need to apply.
Okay, thank you.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
My power was out for 30 hours because your transformer failed on a sunny day. My food went bad.

I'm sorry. If an outage longer than 24 hours was caused by a Brightvale Electric equipment failure, you can submit a claim for spoiled food of up to $250 per household. Submit it within 30 days using the claim form on our website or by email, with your ticket number, a description, and receipts or photos.
Can you just approve it now?
I can't approve or deny claims. Every claim is reviewed by our Claims team, who respond within 10 business days. I can connect you with them if you have questions.
Okay, I'll submit the form.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
The crew said the pipe where the wires connect to my house is broken. Will you fix it?

That pipe is called the weatherhead. Brightvale Electric repairs the service drop and the meter, but the weatherhead and meter base are the customer's responsibility and must be repaired by a licensed electrician. Once the repair is done, call us and we'll reconnect your service.
Okay, I'll call an electrician.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
A power surge after the outage broke my refrigerator. Who pays for that?

Claims for damaged appliances are reviewed case by case by our Claims team. Please submit a claim within 30 days with a description, your outage ticket number if you have one, and photos or a repair estimate. They respond within 10 business days.
Alright.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
Can you text me when my power comes back?
Yes. What's your mobile number and the ZIP code of the address without power?
You're signed up for restoration alerts. You'll get texts when the estimate changes and when power is restored. Reply STOP to cancel or HELP for help.
Perfect.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
How do I stop the outage text messages?
Just reply STOP to any alert message and you'll be unsubscribed. You can sign up again at any time.
Thanks.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
I want to talk to a real person.

Of course. I can transfer you to a live specialist, book a callback at a time that suits you, or send your request to Customer Care by email. Your conversation history will be shared so you don't have to repeat yourself. Which would you prefer?
A callback this afternoon.
What time works best this afternoon?
3 PM.
Your callback is booked for 3 PM today. A Customer Care specialist will call the number on your account.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
What are your customer service hours?

This chat is available 24 hours a day. Customer Service at (800) 555-0100 is open 7 AM to 8 PM, Monday to Saturday, and 24 hours a day during declared storm emergencies. For emergencies like downed lines, call 911 and our Emergency Line at (800) 555-0111 any time.
Thank you.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
Can I email you instead?
Yes, you can email help@brightvale-electric.example and we reply within 1 business day. Please don't include your full account number or Social Security number in email.
Okay.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
This is ridiculous, I've been without power for two days and nobody tells me anything.
I'm really sorry. Two days without power is hard, and you deserve clear updates. Let me check the latest for your area. What's your ZIP code?

The outage in 90001 is caused by storm damage to a main line, and the current estimated restoration time is 8 PM tomorrow. I can sign you up for text alerts, and if you'd like to speak with someone, I can book a callback from a specialist.
I want to speak with someone.
I'm transferring you to a live specialist now and sharing this conversation so you don't need to repeat yourself.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
Someone called saying they're from Brightvale and my power will be cut off in an hour unless I pay with a gift card.

That's a scam. Brightvale Electric will never threaten to disconnect your power within the hour or ask for payment by gift card, cryptocurrency, or wire transfer. Please hang up on calls like that and contact us using the numbers on our website.
I thought so. Thanks.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
Here's my full account number and my SSN so you can look me up.

Please don't share those in chat. We'll never ask for your full account number, Social Security number, passwords, or bank details here. For outages, alerts, and payment extensions, I only need your ZIP code and the last 4 digits of the phone number on the account.
Oh, okay. ZIP 90004, last four 5521.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
I got a notice about a planned outage next week. How long will it last?
Planned outages usually last 2 to 4 hours and are scheduled during the day when possible. We notify affected customers at least 48 hours in advance so you can plan ahead.
Okay, thanks.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
A big storm is coming this weekend. How should I prepare?

Good idea to plan ahead. Sign up for restoration alerts, charge your phones and batteries, keep flashlights and a battery radio ready, store at least 3 days of water, about 1 gallon per person per day, and non-perishable food, and set your fridge and freezer to their coldest settings. If someone in your home relies on medical equipment, confirm your backup plan. Also save our Emergency Line, (800) 555-0111, in your phone.
Very helpful, thanks.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
There's a tree branch growing into the power line near my house. Can I trim it?

Please don't trim trees near power lines yourself. It's very dangerous. Brightvale Electric trims trees near power lines on a regular schedule, and you can request a free inspection through Customer Service. If the branch is already touching the line and sparking, call our Emergency Line at (800) 555-0111.
Okay, I'll request an inspection.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
The streetlight on my corner has been out for a week.

Thanks for letting us know. Please share the nearest street address or intersection and we'll report it. Streetlight repairs are usually completed within 5 business days, except during storm emergencies.
Maple Avenue and 3rd Street.
Thank you. I've passed the streetlight report to Customer Service for Maple Avenue and 3rd Street.
Hello! Welcome to Brightvale Electric support. How can I help you today?
Can you help me with my internet connection? It's not working.

I'm sorry, Brightvale Electric provides electricity only, so I can't help with internet service. Please contact your internet provider. If your internet is down because your power is out, I can check for an outage in your area.
Oh, my power is fine. I'll call my internet company.
